name: app-pill-filters-menu-list-and-payment-card-components
title: Circular filter chips, pill-row settings menu and a lime Default card row on white
whatItIs: A white canvas with three isolated components: four round filter chips (All selected in black), a vertical stack of grey pill rows with arrows for settings and a grey Log out pill in red, and a payment card row with a lime Default pill.
whatItMeans: Tactile and tidy; extreme rounding and grey tones feel friendly and systematic.
techniques: Make list rows full pills with title and grey subtitle.
Use black for selected and pale grey for unselected chips.
Use one lime tag to mark the default option.

vocabulary.definition: A list item shaped like a capsule.
A small toggle for filtering a list.
A label marking the primary choice.
A UI element shown alone on a blank canvas.
